mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quality_agent WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_agent (agent_name, agent_code, agent_type, endpoint_url, auth_token, status, remark, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{agentName}, #{agentCode}, #{agentType}, #{endpointUrl}, #{authToken}, 1, #{remark}, 0, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy})
